
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/voidobject/p/19193198" title="发布于 2025-11-07 14:53">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">从零开始-使用three.Js实现沪深300股票热力图</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>热力图能够直观看到大盘涨跌情况及股票和板块间相关性。平面热力图使用颜色来区分，使用echart报表组件容易实现。但使用3d形式比2D更直观，更有交互性可操作性。</p>
<p><a href="https://gitee.com/wuguiming/hs300-sandbox" rel="noopener nofollow">HS300Sandbox: 使用Three.Js ，展示沪深300涨跌大盘云图。</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p>先看效果图：<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/450118/202511/450118-20251106145548542-1002326105.png" alt="image"></p>
<p>先分析下实现原理：画300个立方体；立方体柱面颜色跟涨跌幅一致，颜色深度表示涨跌程度；用市值大小用高度表示。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>Three.js </strong></span></p>
<p>封装了底层的 WebGL（Web 图形库）API，简化了 3D 渲染的复杂度，让开发者无需深入理解 WebGL 的底层细节，就能快速实现高质量的 3D 效果。</p>
<p>ThreeJs基本要素，包括：</p>
<p>- <strong>场景scence</strong>: 所有 3D 物体、光源、相机等容器。</p>
<p>- <strong>相机Camera</strong>:&nbsp; 以相机视角，决定了场景中的内容哪些部分会被渲染到屏幕上。</p>
<p>- <strong>渲染器 render</strong>:&nbsp; 将场景和相机的内容绘制到网页的canvas元素上。</p>
<p>- <strong>几何体Geomery</strong>: 定义物体的形状</p>
<p>- <strong>材质material</strong>: 定义物体的外观</p>
<p>- <strong>光源 light</strong>: 影响物体的明暗和阴影效果</p>
<p><strong>网格(Mesh):</strong></p>
<p>网格是 3D 计算机图形学中最常见的可见对象，用于显示各种 3D 对象——猫、狗、人类、树木、建筑物、花卉和山脉都可以使用网格来表示。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/450118/202511/450118-20251106151126048-293066168.png" alt="image" width="420" height="245" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>整个过程如下图：</strong></p>
<p>场景(Scene)是一个大舞台，舞台里有个相机(Camera)，相机决定了物体距离感，角度等。场景中的网格就是一个个演员(Mesh)。演员有不同材质(material)的，比如是黑皮肤，白皮肤。脸有长脸，方脸，圆脸等这就几何。把相机的看到的通过放映机(Render）,呈现到幕布(Canvas)上. 整个工作流完成。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/450118/202511/450118-20251106151230572-1138244480.png" alt="image" width="476" height="375" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>Ok,我们已经知道了整个工作流程，比葫芦画瓢，我们按照这个流程开始撸代码。</p>
<p>-1.&nbsp; 准备沪深300成分股。</p>
<p>-2. 初始化场景，相机</p>
<p>-3，画300个立方体，并写文字</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>我们股票数据结构如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>初始化的代码，创建场景，初始化相机，初始化渲染器。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化场景</span>
const scene = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THREE.Scene();
scene.background </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.Color(0xE0E0E0); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 偏灰色背景色</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化相机，设置合理的远裁剪面以适应所有缩放级别</span>
const camera = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 10000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调整相机位置</span>
camera.position.set(12, 20, 12); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提高相机高度和距离，扩大视野</span>
camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 相机看向原点</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化渲染器</span>
const renderer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>原本我准备想画山，实际操作下来太麻烦，根本hold不住，画柱子是最简单。把代码中出现的变量mountains 当成cube立方体即可。初始化完成后，下面主要工作就是循环创建300个立方体。因为代码比较长，只给出了部分功能代码。</p>
<p>代码逻辑是：</p>
<p>- 循环为创建每个立方体，new THREE.BoxBufferGeometry(width, height, depth)</p>
<p>- 循环内，每个立方体添加材质，new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial(), 传入颜色，光泽度等属性</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> generateMountainsFromJSON(data) {

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     const colorConfig =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> createColorConfig();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     mountainData.forEach((item, index) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 存储原始数据，用于时间序列更新</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         item.originalData =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            volume: item.volume,

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>   
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用BoxBufferGeometry创建立方体</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建材质，增加边框效果提高立方体之间的区分度</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         const material = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({

</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>调用generateMountainsFromJSON方法 返回的mountains就是我们想要的立方体。只要把立方体加入到场景中即可。</p>
<div>scene.add(mountain);</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>毛坯房建好了，再加入亿点点小细节：</strong></div>
<div>1，股票的流通市值不一样，我们希望市值大的比较突出。</div>
<div>2.，立方体的颜色，能够反映涨跌幅。</div>
<div>3， 需要给顶部添加文字，标识是哪只票及涨跌数据</div>
<div>4，鼠标移动到立方体上tooltip 提示</div>
<div>5，最好侧面也添加文字</div>
<div>6，可以缩放，转动。</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>好，我们one by one 处理。</div>
<div><strong>1，股票的流通市值不一样，我们希望市值大的比较突出。</strong></div>
<div>我们可以用上沪深300按照市值算出的个股权重，使用立方体高度来衡量。</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算最终高度= 基础高度 + 权重高度 + 涨跌幅高度</span>
        const weightHeight = baseHeight + scaledWeight *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> weightScaleFactor;
        const calculatedHeight </span>= weightHeight + increase *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> increaseScaleFactor;
        const height </span>= Math.max(minHeight, calculatedHeight);</pre>
<div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 使用BoxBufferGeometry创建立方体</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;const geometry = new THREE.BoxBufferGeometry(width, height, depth);</div>
</div>
</div>
<p><strong>2，给立方体添加颜色，反映涨跌</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">　　　　　　//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用BoxBufferGeometry创建立方体</span>
        const geometry = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THREE.BoxBufferGeometry(width, height, depth);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据涨跌幅设置颜色</span>
        let cubeColor =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> colorConfig.getColor(currentIncrease);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建材质，增加边框效果提高立方体之间的区分度</span>
        const material = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: cubeColor,
            shininess: </span>60, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 增加光泽度</span>
            emissive: cubeColor.multiplyScalar(0.2), <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加适当的自发光效果</span>
            wireframe: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            side: THREE.FrontSide,
            transparent: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        });
　　　　  // 将几何体对应材质添加到Mesh网格中
        const mountain </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>3，顶部面添加文字</strong></p>
</div>
<div>还是老样子，场景中的一切都是mesh。创建平面几何--&gt;添加文字材质--&gt;纹理--&gt;添加到Mesh中.</div>
<div>Mesh可以理解是Dom div节点。Mesh与Mesh组成树状结果。</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/450118/202511/450118-20251107120123259-1123120908.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;在three.js中的坐标系是长这个样子的, 补充个重要知识，<span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>正旋转 = 逆时旋转</strong></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/450118/202511/450118-20251107132419392-572066281.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 为立方体添加顶面文字</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> addTextToCube(cube, name, increase, cubeHeight) {
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建Canvas作为文字纹理</span>
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    const context </span>= canvas.getContext('2d'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置字体大小</span>
    const fontSize = 14<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    const increaseFontSize </span>= 12<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    context.font </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `${fontSize}px Arial`;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 限制名称长度</span>
    const maxNameLength = 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    let displayName </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (name.length &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> maxNameLength) {
        displayName </span>= name.substring(0, maxNameLength) + '...'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 格式化涨跌幅为百分比，保留两位小数</span>
    const increasePercent = (increase * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 测量文本宽度和高度</span>
    const nameWidth = context.measureText(displayName).width + 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    context.font </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `${increaseFontSize}px Arial`;
    const increaseWidth </span>= context.measureText(increasePercent).width + 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    const textWidth </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Math.max(nameWidth, increaseWidth);
    const textHeight </span>= (fontSize + increaseFontSize + 12); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 两行文字高度加上间距</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置canvas尺寸</span>
    canvas.width =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> textWidth;
    canvas.height </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> textHeight;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重新设置字体</span>
    context.font =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `${fontSize}px Arial`;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置文本对齐方式</span>
    context.textAlign = 'center'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    context.textBaseline </span>= 'middle'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 强制使用白色文字以确保最高可见性</span>
    context.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加黑色描边以提高对比度和可读性</span>
    context.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    context.lineWidth </span>= 3; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 增加描边宽度以提高文字清晰度</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加阴影效果以增强文字的立体感</span>
    context.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    context.shadowBlur </span>= 4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    context.shadowOffsetX </span>= 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    context.shadowOffsetY </span>= 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绘制第一行：名称</span>
    context.fillText(displayName, textWidth / 2, fontSize + 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绘制第二行：涨跌幅</span>
    context.font =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `${increaseFontSize}px Arial`;
    context.fillText(increasePercent, textWidth </span>/ 2, fontSize + increaseFontSize + 8<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建纹理</span>
    const texture = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    texture.needsUpdate </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建文字材质</span>
    const textMaterial = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        map: texture,
        transparent: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建立方体顶面大小的平面几何体</span>
    const textGeometry = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.PlaneGeometry(FIXED_CUBE_SIZE * 0.8, FIXED_CUBE_SIZE * 0.4); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文字板的大小</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建文字网格</span>
    const textMesh = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THREE.Mesh(textGeometry, textMaterial);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置文字位置在立方体顶面中心</span>
    textMesh.position.set(0, cubeHeight / 2 + 0.1, 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用负角度旋转，确保从顶部观看时文字不被镜像</span>
    textMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将文字添加到立方体</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    cube.add(textMesh);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 确保文字可见性设置正确</span>
    textMesh.visible = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    textMesh.material.visible </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    textMesh.material.opacity </span>= 1.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>4，鼠标移动到立方体上tooltip 提示</strong></p>
<p>判断鼠标是否悬停在立方体顶面，这里需要用到 <strong>Raycaster 射线器</strong>, 它的原理是这样的，可以理解成手电射出一道光，照到某个地方，判断有没有光照到物体(即Mesh网格）。我们可以从相机位置照到鼠标的位置</p>
<p>看有没有重合。就能判断鼠标是不是在某个物体上。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建射线投射器，用于检测鼠标是否悬停在山峰上</span>
const raycaster = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.Vector2();</pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最近悬停的山峰对象</span>
let hoveredMountain = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新鼠标位置</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> updateMousePosition(event) {
    mouse.x </span>= (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    mouse.y </span>= -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检测鼠标悬停</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detectHoveredMountain(event) {
    updateMousePosition(event);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新射线投射器</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算与所有山峰的交点</span>
    const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(mountains ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果有交点</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (intersects.length &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        const intersect </span>= intersects[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
        const mountain </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> intersect.object;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果悬停在新的山峰上</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (mountain !==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hoveredMountain) {
            hoveredMountain </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mountain;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 动态获取当前时间点的涨跌幅数据，而不是使用静态的mountain.name</span>
            const currentIncrease = increaseData[mountain.code] || 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            const increasePercent </span>= (currentIncrease * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提取mountain.name中的名称部分（不含涨跌幅信息）</span>
            let displayName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mountain.name;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (displayName.includes(' - 涨跌幅:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)) {
                displayName </span>= displayName.split(' - 涨跌幅:')[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置tooltip文本为名称和当前时间点的涨跌幅</span>
            tooltip.textContent = `${displayName} -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 涨跌幅: ${increasePercent}`;
            tooltip.style.left </span>= event.clientX + 10 + 'px'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            tooltip.style.top </span>= event.clientY - 30 + 'px'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            tooltip.style.display </span>= 'block'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新tooltip位置和内容，确保始终显示最新数据</span>
            const currentIncrease = increaseData[mountain.code] || 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            const increasePercent </span>= (currentIncrease * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

            let displayName </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mountain.name;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (displayName.includes(' - 涨跌幅:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)) {
                displayName </span>= displayName.split(' - 涨跌幅:')[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
            }

            tooltip.textContent </span>= `${displayName} -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 涨跌幅: ${increasePercent}`;
            tooltip.style.left </span>= event.clientX + 10 + 'px'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            tooltip.style.top </span>= event.clientY - 30 + 'px'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 没有悬停在任何山峰上</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (hoveredMountain !== <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
            hoveredMountain </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            tooltip.style.display </span>= 'none'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>关于第5点，侧面添加文字跟顶面添加文本逻辑类似，不再赘述。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 15px">6，可以缩放，转动</span></strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px">缩放，转动，可以直接使用 OrbitControls.js插件来实现。</span></p>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> constructor(scene, camera, renderer, options =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">window.THREE) {
            console.error(</span>'THREE.js 未正确加载'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">window.THREE.OrbitControls) {
            console.error(</span>'OrbitControls 插件未正确加载'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.scene =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scene;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.camera =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> camera;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.renderer =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> renderer;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化OrbitControls，使用renderer的canvas元素作为事件监听器的目标元素</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这样可以避免与页面上的UI控件（如下拉菜单）产生事件冲突</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer &amp;&amp; renderer.domElement ?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> renderer.domElement : document.body);
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置控制参数</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.enableDamping = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 启用阻尼效果，使旋转更平滑</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.dampingFactor = options.dampingFactor || 0.05; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 阻尼系数</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.rotateSpeed = options.rotateSpeed || 0.5; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 旋转速度，设置较低值使控制更精确</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.zoomSpeed = options.zoomSpeed || 0.5; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 缩放速度，设置较低值使控制更精确</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.panSpeed = options.panSpeed || 0.5; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 平移速度</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置最小和最大距离</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.minDistance = options.minDistance || 200; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 相机最小距离</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.maxDistance = options.maxDistance || 2000; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 相机最大距离</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置最小和最大极角，控制垂直方向的旋转范围</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.minPolarAngle = 0; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最小极角（俯视角度限制）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI / 2; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最大极角（仰视角度限制），这里设为π/2，即90度</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置目标点，相机将围绕这个点旋转</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.target.set(0, 0, 0); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 围绕原点旋转</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 禁用平移控制，只保留旋转和缩放</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.controls.enablePan = options.enablePan || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新控制器，应用初始设置</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.controls.update();
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>主要是初始化&nbsp;&nbsp;new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer &amp;&amp; renderer.domElement ? renderer.domElement : document.body); 指定相机和监控的区域。在配置些相关参数。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 页面加载完成后执行</span>
window.addEventListener('load', async () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成box</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    loadDataAndGenerateMountains();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化鼠标交互控制器，传入renderer以避免与UI控件的事件冲突</span>
    mouseController =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)"><strong> createMouseInteractionController</strong></span>(scene, camera, renderer,
        {
            rotateSpeed: </span>0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            zoomSpeed: </span>0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            minDistance: </span>200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            maxDistance: </span>2000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        });</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>至此我们已经完成了功能。但是我们发现，物体有点暗。这里我需要调整下光源，好比把屋子里的灯亮度加大。如何做？</p>
<p>我们来学习下光照。我们的眼睛是使用物体表面阴影的差异来确定深度。如果我们不在场景中添加某种形式的光照，它看起来不是3d的。可以使用直接或环境光，或者将光照作为基于图像的光照存储在纹理中。</p>
<p>如果你在一个黑暗的房间里打开一个灯泡，那个房间里的物体会以两种方式接收到光：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>直接照明</strong>：直接来自灯泡并撞击物体的光线。</li>
<li><strong>间接照明</strong>：光线在击中物体之前已经从墙壁和房间内的其他物体反弹，每次反弹都会改变颜色并失去强度。</li>
</ol>
<p>与这些相匹配，three.js 中的灯光类分为两种类型：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>直接光照</strong>，模拟直接光照。</li>
<li><strong>环境光</strong>，这是&nbsp;<em>一种</em>&nbsp;廉价且可信的间接照明方式。</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong><code>DirectionalLight</code>&nbsp;=&gt; 阳光</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>PointLight</code>&nbsp;=&gt; 灯泡</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>RectAreaLight</code>&nbsp;=&gt; 条形照明或明亮的窗户</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>SpotLight</code>&nbsp;=&gt; 聚光灯</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<div>AmbientLight&nbsp;<strong>=&gt; 环境光</strong></div>
</li>
</ul>
<p>我们在舞台场景中，加些灯光既可。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加更强的光源，提高整体对比度</span>
const ambientLight = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.AmbientLight(0x808080); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 增强环境光</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">scene.add(ambientLight);

const directionalLight </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 增强主光源</span>
directionalLight.position.set(2, 3, 2); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调整光源位置</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">scene.add(directionalLight);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加辅助光源，提高立体感</span>
const fillLight = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
fillLight.position.set(</span>-3, 2, -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
scene.add(fillLight);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>OK，至此我们大功告成，实现了立体式的大盘涨跌云图。吊不吊。</p>
</div>
<p>完整代码，Gitee 自取。<a href="https://gitee.com/wuguiming/hs300-sandbox" rel="noopener nofollow">HS300Sandbox: 使用Three.Js ，展示沪深300涨跌大盘云图。</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p>代码中还包含了实时涨幅动态展示，但是呈现起来效果不够好，也未找到很好方法。</p>
</div>
</div>
